geometrySource.note: Track centreline from the circuit’s OpenStreetMap route relation. No Formula 1 session has run here, so there is no position telemetry: corner positions are measured from the centreline’s curvature rather than read from FastF1, and speeds are unavailable until a car runs. The start/finish line is not mapped; it is placed on the main straight, which the pit lane identifies by running alongside it.
